notes: Official Raspberry Pi Ltd STEP models, published on the Product Information Portal 11 Jun 2026 (files dated 2026-05-27). They supersede the older datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi5/RaspberryPi5-step.zip, which now redirects to the no-graphics zip. Matches the team render (green Pi 5 with silver USB/Ethernet). One model covers all RAM variants; on real boards a silkscreen checkbox (1G/2G/4G/8G) marks the RAM size, so the 8GB variant is not modelled separately. Mass is not published by Raspberry Pi. Product names inside the STEP are anonymised (OBJn), so identify sub-bodies by colour and geometry. Raw vertex bboxes are in local frames and are not world-space.
conversion_warning: tools/inspect.mjs (occt-import-js 0.0.23) and an absolute-deflection run (0.05 mm, angular 0.5) both read rpi-5b_no_graphics.step with success=true and 2711 meshes (one per STYLED_ITEM), but every mesh has 0 triangles, so no bbox comes out. The B-rep looks normal (PLANE/CYLINDRICAL/SPHERICAL surfaces, mm units, uncertainty 2e-5), so this is an importer problem, not missing geometry. Parse time about 4.5 min for the 77 MB file. To tessellate it, try FreeCAD/CadQuery (OCP) or a newer occt-import-js. The with_graphics file was not tried with occt (same exporter, 142 MB).
